messages:
Nadia: quick feedback from QA on the new auth settings form 11 fields feel too close vertically when skeleton loaders are present. looks cramped during load and then jumps when real inputs render. screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/form-skeleton-jump.png
Eli: yeah i noticed that. skeleton uses `space-2` gaps but inputs use `space-4`. propose a `form-row-gap` token and apply it to both skeletons and inputs so the height doesn't shift. values: compact=8, regular=16.
Katherine: accessibility: when skeletons are present, NVDA reads "loading" but jumps caret when inputs mount. ensure skeletons are inert (aria-hidden) and announce a single live update when form is ready instead of per-field announces.
Vik: CTA state: primary button is disabled during load but shows a tooltip "Loading..." that steals hover and hides the disabled state. maybe just show a subtle spinner inside the button and remove tooltip. also ensure disabled color contrast meets 3:1 for visibility.
Nadia: agreed on spinner. microcopy: button should say "Updating settings" when action in progress, not just "Save". helps set expectation.
Eli: proposed CSS fix: keep container height stable with `min-height` and use `visibility: hidden` for placeholders then fade in. Sample: `.form-row { min-height: 48px; } .skeleton { height: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; }`
Katherine: keyboard focus order note: after save, focus currently jumps to the toast which is confusing. keep focus on the primary button or move to a confirmation heading inside the form, not the toast. toasts should be `aria-live=polite` only.
Vik: AuditBot: accessibility checklist run shows two failures: skeletons not `aria-hidden` and disabled button contrast. Filing issues: RED-432, RED-433.
Nadia: can we also standardize when to use compact vs regular form rows? settings panels use compact; full flows (onboarding) use regular. document in Form component README.
Eli: i'll open a PR that adds `form-row-gap` token, harmonizes skeleton markup (aria-hidden), swaps tooltip for inline spinner in button, and adds a tiny e2e test to assert no layout shift on 375px width.
Katherine: i'll validate the screen reader experience once PR lands. thanks team :pray:
